row.evidence: Plane's Enterprise page says Enterprise Grid (quote on request) adds 'SCIM and LDAP provisioning' over Business; the pricing page lists SAML/OIDC from Business ($13/seat/mo annual).
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated, Enterprise Grid, quote on request). Prices unchanged: Pro $6 and Business $13 per seat/mo billed annually ($8/$15 monthly). SAML and OIDC SSO are on Business; LDAP, IdP group sync and API-enabled audit logs are Enterprise Grid. SCIM is only named on the marketing Enterprise page; no SCIM setup guide, endpoint or attribute list is published in docs.plane.so or developers.plane.so (sitemaps and llms.txt searched), so all SCIM behaviour fields are null and docs_url points to the Enterprise page. IdP group sync (SSO-time and scheduled offline sync for OIDC/LDAP) is documented for self-hosted Commercial and Airgapped editions. No Okta, Entra or JumpCloud catalogue app found. SSO creates accounts on first sign-in (JIT).
